title: Nick Bosa says he felt great at practice, expects to play vs. Rams in Australia

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Nick Bosa says he felt great at practice, expects to play vs. Rams in Australia
sources.description: 49ers defensive end Nick Bosa returned to practice today, and afterward he said he thinks he'll be good to go for next week's regular-season opener against the Rams in Australia.
